Reads the list of deaths that we extracted using Malena's three spreadsheets. 

Convert these to one row per cause, not one row per death, and match the causes to the recoded death code data that I created with Claude Code. 


```{r}
#| label: setup

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here)

i_am("death-certificates/05-code-deaths.qmd")


```

Load the list of deaths, and separate them into one row per cause of death from the rac. 

```{r}
#| label: convert-wide-to-long



cause_per_row <- 
  readRDS(here("death-certificates/processed/02-icf-deaths.RDS")) |>  
  select ( death_id, df_source, manner, autop, man_uc, `Facility Name`, lname, acme_uc,  rac) |> 
  separate_rows ( rac, sep = "\\s+")  |> 
  group_by ( death_id) |> 
  mutate ( order = row_number()) |> 
  ungroup()



```



```{r}
#| label: get-sentinel-list

cod_codes <- 
  readRDS(here("death-certificates/processed/04-sentinel-lookup.RDS"))

# janitor::get_dupes(cod_codes, code)


```

Check for codes that aren't in the sentinel list. The join below drops them silently, so this should come back empty. If new deaths bring new codes, add them to `04-sentinel-lookup.r` and re-run it first.

```{r}
#| label: check-missing-codes

cause_per_row |>
  anti_join ( cod_codes, join_by ( rac == code)) |>
  count ( rac)

```

```{r}
#| label: match-cod-codes

causes_coded <-
  cause_per_row |>
  inner_join ( cod_codes, join_by ( rac == code))


```

Roll back up to one row per death. Each death gets the highest sentinel level among all of its causes, the level of the underlying cause, and flags for combinations of codes that are worth a closer look. The flags mark records to review. They are not findings of neglect.

- `flag_infection_swallow`: sepsis or pneumonia along with a sign of swallowing risk (difficulty swallowing, cerebral palsy, severe or profound intellectual disability, quadriplegia, vomiting)
- `flag_ill_defined_only`: cardiac arrest, sudden cardiac death or unknown cause, with nothing else listed except lifelong conditions
- `flag_seizure_sudden`: epilepsy or seizures along with a sudden or ill-defined death
- `flag_assault_sequela`: lasting effects of an earlier assault (Y871); the injury may predate the ICF stay
- `flag_disability_only`: every cause listed is a lifelong condition (level 0), such as cerebral palsy, or epilepsy; none of these explains the death by itself, and with epilepsy it may point to a seizure-related death
- `flag_bowel_unexplained`: a blocked or stalled bowel with no other explanation listed (cancer, hernia, surgery, loss of blood supply); in this population, often hardened stool from untreated constipation
- `flag_seizure_pneumonia`: epilepsy or seizures along with pneumonia, which may be aspiration recorded as ordinary pneumonia
- `flag_terminal_context`: a level 3 death whose underlying cause is a terminal illness (cancer, dementia, Parkinson's, MS, motor neuron disease, end-stage kidney or liver disease), and whose level 3 causes are only ones that often come with end of life (aspiration pneumonia, malnutrition, dehydration, bedsores). This lowers concern rather than raising it, so it's left out of `needs_review` and the death stays at level 3. Choking, falls, injuries, cold exposure and poisoning never get this flag.

```{r}
#| label: roll-up-deaths

sepsis      <- "^A41"
pneumonia   <- "^J1[0-8]|^J69"
swallow     <- "^(R13|G80.|F72|F73|G824|G825|R11)$"
ill_defined <- "^(I461|I469|R99)$"
seizure     <- "^(G40.|R568)$"
sudden      <- "^(I461|I469|R99|R092)$"
bowel_block <- "^(K56.|K598)$"
bowel_cause <- "^(C|K913|K4[0-35-6]|K55|Y83)"
terminal_uc <- "^(C|F01|F03|G30|G20|G35|G122|N185|K72|K746)"
end_of_life <- "^(J690|E43|E46|E86|E870|L89.)$"

deaths_coded <-
  causes_coded |>
  mutate ( uc = coalesce ( na_if ( man_uc, ""), acme_uc)) |>
  group_by ( death_id, df_source, manner, autop, `Facility Name`, lname, uc) |>
  summarise (
    n_causes = n(),
    all_causes = paste ( rac, collapse = " "),
    all_causes_by_level = paste ( rac[order ( -sentinel_level)], collapse = " "),
    top_codes = paste ( rac[sentinel_level == max ( sentinel_level)], collapse = "; "),
    top_labels = paste ( short_label[sentinel_level == max ( sentinel_level)], collapse = "; "),
    # most serious area first
    care_areas = paste ( unique ( care_focus_area[order ( -sentinel_level)]), collapse = "; "),
    max_level = max ( sentinel_level),
    flag_infection_swallow = any ( str_detect ( rac, sepsis) | str_detect ( rac, pneumonia)) &
                             any ( str_detect ( rac, swallow)),
    flag_ill_defined_only  = any ( str_detect ( rac, ill_defined)) &
                             all ( sentinel_level == 0 | str_detect ( rac, ill_defined)),
    flag_seizure_sudden    = any ( str_detect ( rac, seizure)) & any ( str_detect ( rac, sudden)),
    flag_assault_sequela   = any ( rac == "Y871"),
    flag_disability_only   = all ( sentinel_level == 0 | str_detect ( rac, "^G40")),
    flag_bowel_unexplained = any ( str_detect ( rac, bowel_block)) & !any ( str_detect ( rac, bowel_cause)),
    flag_seizure_pneumonia = any ( str_detect ( rac, seizure)) & any ( str_detect ( rac, pneumonia)),
    flag_terminal_context  = max_level == 3 & str_detect ( first ( uc), terminal_uc) &
                             all ( str_detect ( rac[sentinel_level == 3], end_of_life)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join (
    cod_codes |> select ( code, uc_description = description, uc_care_area = care_focus_area, uc_level = sentinel_level),
    join_by ( uc == code)
  ) |>
  # terminal context lowers concern, so it doesn't count toward review
  mutate ( needs_review = if_any ( c ( starts_with ( "flag_"), -flag_terminal_context))  & max_level < 3
    )


deaths_coded |>
  summarise ( across ( c ( starts_with ( "flag_"), needs_review), sum))

deaths_coded |>
  count ( max_level, uc_level)

```


Save the one-row-per-death file for the teammate summary.

```{r}
#| label: save-deaths-coded

saveRDS(deaths_coded, here("death-certificates/processed/05-deaths-coded.RDS"))
saveRDS(causes_coded, here("death-certificates/processed/05-causes-coded.RDS"))

```
